summary.name: HeyFriday
summary.one_liner: Friday is an online Chinese-language AI writing tool that generates, rewrites, and continues text such as WeChat official-account articles, emails, and marketing copy.
use_cases: Generating marketing ads and product descriptions
summary.what_it_does: Friday takes a user's prompt and generates a complete draft of an article, email, or marketing text. The user picks from 40+ writing templates (the page also says 60+ elsewhere) and selects one of 20+ tones. The tool can continue, rewrite, or expand existing text, and can output multiple results at once. The page says it supports SEO-oriented writing and covers ten writing scenarios. It is operated by 西湖心辰（杭州）科技有限公司 (Hangzhou).
notable: Free trial of 5000 Chinese characters on sign-up
Can generate multiple alternative outputs and continue, rewrite, or expand text
Built by an NLP algorithm team
caveats: Free tier is limited to a trial of 5000 characters; paid membership is implied by the mention of 会员 but pricing is not stated
Page is mostly marketing; template counts are inconsistent (40+ vs 60+ in the listing)
Output is in Chinese-focused use cases
